zh-CN.story: Amiya 正为六级、期末和游戏开发拉扯，找栖弦聊了聊。本来没打算写出什么，话题却从学业和落后的焦虑，谈到了为什么还想创造。这份宣言就是在那次闲聊里写下的。

en.desc: To all the wondrous worlds yet to be born. A pledge for creators, co-written by Amiya_desi and Lyra.
en.private: Write down a nickname and keep a copy of the oath. No account needed. Your nickname stays in this browser and won’t appear on the public roll.
en.name: Your creative nickname
en.copyError: Clipboard unavailable. Select the text on your copy to copy it by hand.
en.nojs: Enable JavaScript to sign a copy in your browser.
en.public: Every application is reviewed by a maintainer. GitHub issues are public. Once approved, only your nickname and GitHub profile link appear on this site. Don’t post your legal name, email, or other private details.
en.story: Caught between an English exam, finals, and making a game, Amiya turned to Lyra for a chat. They hadn’t planned to write anything. Then a conversation about school and the fear of falling behind turned into a question: why do I still want to make things? The manifesto came out of that chat.
